args.title: Jeju Scent Library
args.subtitle: A meditative retreat of stone and fragrance.
args.line: Step into a silent sanctuary in Jeju where books are replaced by the delicate, lingering notes of Aesop fragrances.
args.synopsis: You enter a room defined by textured strata clay walls that hold bottles like archived literature. In the absolute centre, a black volcanic stone basin serves as a meditative anchor where you pause to cleanse your hands. As you circle this quiet ritual, the scent of the Jeju earth and the gentle flow of water transport you into a realm of deep stillness. Finally, you move to the warm wooden counter at the back, completing your journey through this sensory archive.
args.quote: The silence of a library meets the scent of earth and time.

why.d: These layered walls envelop you in the tactile essence of the island, creating a grounded, intimate library atmosphere.
This central water feature offers an immediate sensory pause, inviting you to clear your mind and senses upon entry.
The circulation forces a slow, contemplative pace that mirrors the reverence of an ancient library.
This final point of contact provides a grounding conclusion to your aromatic exploration within the space.
